tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Most of the screen is this colour. Paper is a cool off-white, not cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inset areas only: code blocks, input fills on hover, a selected table row. Do not use it to make cards. Use a hairline instead.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, primary button fill. 14:1 or more on bg in all themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, help text, metadata. 5.8:1 or more on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and section rules. Decorative only: it is too light to be the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. 3:1 or more on bg, so a control stays visible. Also disabled text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent. Use it for one thing per screen at most: the focus ring, the current item, or one key link. Never for fills larger than a button. 7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. 7:1 on accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. Alias of accent.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most. Light weight; size does the work.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles. Regular weight, not bold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Thin lines and open space carry the structure, so the words can stay plain.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines under 72 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and help text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, values a person types, IDs.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and readouts, so columns align.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and table headers. Sentence case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins on wide screens. Negative space is a feature: do not fill it.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, inputs, panels, images.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only for round status dots (6px). Nothing else is round.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: All borders and rules.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Outlines of alert glyphs. At 16px a 1px outline is too faint to tell the glyphs apart.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, and the underline of the current item. The only thick line.
